acceptance_criteria: All 17 theory/model targets are independently generated without raw, reference, author-code, author-array, or source-pixel inputs.

Poisson/GOE normalization, collision conservation, quadratic energy scaling, classical E^-3/4 loss, polarization unitarity/threshold/barrier laws, and partial-wave peak behavior pass their machine checks.
Missing author experimental arrays remain four explicit missing_author_data blockers rather than reconstructed points.
All 32 config-and-implementation-hash-bound shards complete or resume without seed overlap.
Every printed energy condition aggregates exactly 262144 float64 trajectories after 800 collision updates per trajectory.
The 121-point polarization grid and 131072-sample three-body averages produce all 17 target artifacts and pass all scientific checks.
CUDA on the available A100 is used when present; NumPy is an equivalent slower backend and no GPU-only numerical shortcut changes the model.
Omitted author MD inputs and f-wave short-range parameters remain reconstructed, preventing paper-exact promotion even after a full campaign.
